name: hashimon-server
description: Authoritative Hashimon server — Phase 1: identity, inventory, emission. A referee, not an oracle.

scripts.build: tsc --noEmit && esbuild src/server.ts src/db/migrate.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node22 --packages=external --outdir=dist && cp src/db/schema.sql dist/db/schema.sql
scripts.test: node --import tsx --test src/core/core.test.ts src/domain/auth.test.ts src/domain/block-template.test.ts src/domain/bitcoin-address.test.ts src/http/wide-event.test.ts src/domain/magi.test.ts
